title: Jaljeera
description: A tangy, digestive cumin and mint cooler made with jaljeera powder, lemon and a touch of sugar.
steps: Stir the jaljeera powder, sugar, black salt and roasted cumin powder into 100 ml of the cold water until dissolved.
Add the lemon juice and mint leaves.
Pour in the remaining water and mix well.
Let it stand for 10 minutes so the flavours develop, then chill and serve over ice.
